answer: Put Certified cleaning supervisor shift log with cleaning supervisors endorsement at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Cloning 729 keys multiplies the price 729-fold: 86751 POA locked, or 10206 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One mirror of signal, one atlas of cost, one plume of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
